A small model, with clear boundaries.

Fixed coupons, fixed redemption at face value, and valuation on a coupon date immediately after payment. No accrued interest, defaults, calls, fees or taxes. A single yield discounts every cash flow. This is a learning model, not a live bond quote.

Duration, convexity & solver conventions

Macaulay duration = Σ(time in years × present value) / price. Modified duration = Macaulay duration / (1 + y/m). Convexity = Σ[t(t+1) × PV] / [price × m² × (1+y/m)²]. Here t counts periods and y is a decimal annual yield. For a small change Δy, ΔP/P ≈ −modified duration × Δy. Larger changes need convexity or full repricing. Yield is solved by bisection; it is not a guarantee of realised return.
